copy.tagline: 快速查询SaaS财务指标和基准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要查SaaS财务指标定义和公式
copy.tagline_en: Look up SaaS finance metrics, formulas, and benchmarks quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need quick definitions and formulas for SaaS financial metrics

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会变成SaaS财务指标速查工具。当你询问某个指标时，它会直接给出定义、公式、好坏基准和警示信号，也会提供决策框架和健康检查清单。
howto.when: 当你需要快速查询SaaS财务指标的定义、公式或基准时触发，例如问“NRR的公式是什么？”或“CAC payback是多少？”。

say.text: NRR的公式是什么？好的基准是多少？
say.note: 技能会返回公式和基准数值。

say.text: 给我CAC payback和Rule of 40的快速参考。
say.note: 技能会列出公式、基准和评估标准。

say.text: 我需要一份SaaS指标速查表，用于业务评审。
say.note: 技能会提供完整指标表格和决策框架。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a fast lookup tool for SaaS finance metrics. When you ask about a metric, it provides the definition, formula, good benchmark, and red flag, plus decision frameworks and health checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a quick definition, formula, or benchmark for a SaaS finance metric, e.g., asking "What is the formula for NRR and what is a good benchmark?"

say_en.text: What is the formula for NRR and what is a good benchmark?
Give me a quick reference for CAC payback and Rule of 40.
say_en.note: Skill lists formulas, benchmarks, and evaluation criteria.

say_en.text: I need a SaaS metrics cheat sheet for a business review.
say_en.note: Skill provides full metrics table and decision frameworks.
